description: Rive de routes départementales faisant office de berge de rivières - Département du Territoire de Belfort is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.territoiredebelfort.fr. Inventory of departmental roads close to rivers and whose public domains are confused. Typically, the bank wall of the river supporting the causeway of the departmental road. This concomitance of public domains concerns about 10 kilometers of watercourses (or departmental roads). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "River of departmental roads acting as banks of rivers - Department of the Territory of Belfort" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include routes départementales, rivières. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
